00044 NeuralLayerSimpleInternal::NeuralLayerSimpleInternal(const int numNodes, const int numNodesOnPreviousLayer) throw()
00045 : nodes(numNodes < 1 ? 1 : numNodes),
00046  outputVector(NumericalArray<float>::newClear(nodes.size())),
00047  inputVector(NumericalArray<float>::newClear(numNodesOnPreviousLayer < 1 ? 1 : numNodesOnPreviousLayer)),
00048  adjustVector(NumericalArray<float>::newClear(inputVector.size()))
00049 { 
00050  const int numWeights = inputVector.size();
00051  const int size = nodes.size();
00052  for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00053  {
00054   nodes[i] = NeuralNode(numWeights);
00055  }
00056 }
00057 
00058 void NeuralLayerSimpleInternal::init(const float weightMaximum) throw()

00096 NumericalArray<float>& NeuralLayerSimpleInternal::propogate(NumericalArray<float> const& _inputVector) throw()
00097 {
00098  memcpy(inputVector.getArray(), _inputVector.getArray(), inputVector.size() * sizeof(float));
00099  
00100  float* outputVectorPtr = outputVector.getArray();
00101  
00102  NeuralNode *nodesPtr = nodes.getArray();
00103  const int size = nodes.size();
00104  for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00105  {
00106   outputVectorPtr[i] = nodesPtr[i].propogate(inputVector);
00107  } 
00108  
00109  return outputVector;
00110 }

00112 NumericalArray<float>& NeuralLayerSimpleInternal::backProp(NumericalArray<float>& errorVector, const float actFuncOffset, const float learnRate) throw()
00113 {
00114  memset(adjustVector.getArray(), 0, adjustVector.size() * sizeof(float));
00115  
00116  float* errorVectorPtr = errorVector.getArray();
00117  
00118  NeuralNode *nodesPtr = nodes.getArray();
00119  const int size = nodes.size();
00120  for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00121  {
00122   nodesPtr[i].backProp(inputVector, errorVectorPtr[i], actFuncOffset, learnRate, adjustVector);
00123  }
00124  
00125  return adjustVector;
00126 }
